metadata.title: EldarVisual | Custom Websites & Apps
metadata.description: Website and app design and development for businesses, organizations, and nonprofits. New projects, improvements to existing websites, and personal guidance from Aviram Eldar.
metadata.ogDescription: Custom websites and apps, with clear content, thoughtful design, and personal guidance from planning to launch.

hero.title: Custom Websites
hero.subtitle: For businesses, organizations, and nonprofits that need a new website, a clearer existing site, or an app built around their work. Help visitors understand what you offer and take the next step.
hero.tags: Personal guidance from Aviram Eldar · Planning through launch
hero.reviewNote: Have a website already? Start with a written review of its content, navigation, and user experience.

services.subtitle: What We Do
services.title: What Does Your

items.title: Improve an Existing Website
items.desc: For a website that no longer represents your business or makes it hard for visitors to find what they need. Start by identifying what to change and what to keep.
features: Clearer layouts and calls to action

items.title: Build a New Website
items.desc: For a business or organization that needs a website of its own. Present your services, work, or activities clearly and make it easy to get in touch.
features: Interface design for desktop and mobile
Launch and a walkthrough of the site

items.title: Plan & Build an App
items.desc: For a service or workflow that needs more than a website. Define the users, essential features, and screens before choosing the technical solution.
features: Clarifying the need and main features
Integrations according to the agreed scope

services.additionalDesc: Interface design, content organization, online stores, and ongoing maintenance can be included according to the needs of your project. The scope is agreed together.

process.subtitle: Workflow
process.title: From the First Conversation
process.step1_desc: We clarify your goals, who will use the website or app, and what they need to do. For an existing site, we also look at what is and is not working.
process.step2_desc: I organize the content, plan the screens, and design the interface. You review the direction before development begins.
process.step3_desc: I develop the agreed features and check the layout, navigation, and forms across desktop and mobile.
process.step4_desc: We prepare the site for launch and go over how to use it. Any ongoing maintenance is defined separately according to your needs.

portfolio.demoDesc: Independent demonstrations of design and development. These are not client commissions or evidence of business results.

contact.subtitle: Get in Touch
contact.title: Define · Design
contact.desc1: Tell me what you need, whether it is a new website, an app, or an improvement to an existing site.
contact.desc2: I will review your message and contact you to clarify the scope and the next step. You do not need to have a website already.

form.goalPlaceholder: Tell me about the website, app, or improvement you have in mind.
form.successDesc: Thank you. I will review your request and reply to the email address you provided to discuss the next step.
form.websiteHint: Optional, including for a review request. You can also mention the site in your message.
form.reviewScope: A first look at the content, navigation, and user experience, with a short written summary and suggested next steps. It does not include a security audit, code review, or a comprehensive technical test.
form.reviewTiming: I will confirm the review scope and delivery timing with you by email.
form.nextStep: After you send the form, I will review the details and reply by email. There is no commitment to start a project.
form.requiredNote: Only your name, email, and a short description are required.
form.validationWebsite: Enter a full website address starting with https:// or http://.
form.validationServer: Please check this field and try again.
form.errorMessage: Your message could not be sent. Your details are still here. Try again, or contact me by email.
form.privacyNote: Your details are used to respond to your enquiry.

contact.aboutDesc: I am the person behind Eldar Visual. I work directly with you on planning, design, development, and launch, so the conversation and the work stay connected throughout the project.
